draft.title: Waybill: Procurement lead outreach test
draft.purpose: Validate the founder's request for intros to hardware procurement leads by identifying target companies, decision-makers and outreach channels.

sections.heading: Questions for the founder
sections.content: Which hardware enterprises have you engaged with? What are their procurement processes and pain points? What channels do they use for sourcing? What is the typical approval workflow for procurement decisions?

sections.heading: Outreach procedure and recording sheet
sections.content: Propose a list of 10-15 hardware enterprises with procurement needs. Record contact details, decision-makers, approval workflows, and current sourcing channels. Track outreach attempts, responses and follow-up actions.

sections.heading: Decision after the test
sections.content: Compare the number of successful contacts with the founder's outreach goals. If fewer than 50% of contacts respond, refine the list or adjust the outreach strategy. Document the response rate and engagement quality.

missing_inputs.record: Hardware enterprise procurement contact list and decision-maker roles
missing_inputs.why: They define the outreach scope and help validate the founder's ability to connect with procurement leads.
